summary: Sync must resume from a real upstream cursor and propagate failures; auto-refresh must not falsely advance freshness. SearchApis must treat an empty query as "match everything".
reason: The generated sync loop wrote a wall-clock timestamp as its "cursor" (never resumable, never paginated past page one), swallowed hard fetch/decode failures into an always-success exit, and the auto-refresh hook advanced the local freshness marker without ever fetching anything. The store's empty-query search path also short-circuited to zero rows instead of the full cache, breaking the default (unfiltered) export command.
validated_outcome: go test ./... green (new pagination/failure-propagation/freshness/empty-query regression coverage); go build, go vet, go mod tidy, govulncheck, and the SKILL.md verifier all pass.
